description: Get WhatsApp messages from a specific chat. This is the source of truth for actual message content: use it whenever the question is about what someone said/wrote. Entries include non-text events too (check the "type" field: "chat" = text message, "call_log" = call, "ptt" = voice note, "image"/"video" = media; non-text entries may have an empty "body").

chat_id.description: The JID of the chat to retrieve messages from (e.g., 123456789@c.us or 123456789-12345678@g.us)

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return

name: list_messages
